description:
A superb one-bedroom apartment within the sought-after Centurion Square development, quietly positioned just off Skeldergate. Only a short stroll from York’s historic city centre, this well-appointed home offers stylish, low-maintenance living in an exceptional location. 
The property features a bright openplan living and kitchen area complete with modern appliances including a fridge/freezer, washing machine and dishwasher. The generous double bedroom provides a comfortable retreat, while the spacious bathroom includes a contemporary white suite with a shower over the bath. 
Residents also benefit from access to well-maintained, peaceful communal gardens, offering a tranquil outdoor space in the heart of the city. 
This apartment is an excellent choice for an investor, professional or couple seeking to enjoy the convenience and atmosphere of York’s vibrant urban lifestyle.

Please note that the AML fee covers the cost of carrying out the required identity and anti-money laundering checks. Once these checks have been completed, the fee cannot be refunded, even if the property purchase does not go ahead.
